notes.title: 1.0 Version is Uploaded & Release is Tomorrow!
notes.content:
What has been done: 

- Some players had issues when starting the game, they were "flying arround". Now all players will start, functional backup system is in place 

- Camera fixes 

- Voice/text adjustments 

- Animation fixes 

- Pathfinding 

- Ability System got a backup system, to make sure the game doesn´t break 

- Balancing, many units got small changes 

  

What is still there:  

  

- In the Toxic Temple frame drops still happen, it is less than before. However, to be honest, I don´t know how to fully fix it. It is not breaking the game; it just becomes slower on one map. 

- Sarah still puts her hand into the ground... nothing breaking the game. Sorry, it's still on my list. 

Looking foreword to hear your Feedback. 

  

Tomorrow is Release!
